_help: Settings for the Etsy sync (scripts/etsy-sync.mjs), which only adds NEW Etsy listings. skipTitles: listings whose title starts with any of these are never added. ignoreListingIds: Etsy listing ids to never add. sectionCategories: which shop section a new listing goes in, matched against its Etsy section name. maxNewPerRun: safety stop. newBadgeDays: how long a new item shows the 'New' badge.
